verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's docs publish 1,440 GB of total GPU memory across 8 B200 GPUs (about 180 GB per GPU). That comfortably fits a 70B-class quantized model on a single DGX B200 node, and NVIDIA positions the system for LLM inference with a claimed 15X inference gain. The only bandwidth figure in the pack is the 14.4 TB/s NVLink aggregate, which is interconnect bandwidth, not per-GPU HBM memory bandwidth. Missing for 10: published per-GPU HBM memory bandwidth, an explicit per-GPU VRAM spec, 70B-class inference benchmarks or hands-on reports, and evidence for local or single-GPU (non-DGX) deployment.
